Before you pay anything into someone else's stokvel, ask: Can I see the constitution? Where is the money kept, and who has to sign before money comes out? Can I see last year's records? What happens if I need to leave early? And when, exactly, do I get paid? If the answer is "don't worry, trust us", be careful, and never pay your contribution into someone's personal account. And if someone promises your stokvel will double your money, or pays old members with new members' money, that's not a stokvel. That's a scheme. Walk away.

Full guide: "Stokvels Explained: How to Protect Your Stokvel Money (South Africa 2026)" on the Money From Zero channel.
